query: Same real DCUrbanMom incident as prompt #3, different angle: a child wearing our facility's yellow proficiency wristband (chest-depth only; has NOT passed the deep-water tread / swim-to-the-side test) is in line for the diving board over 10 feet of water. Her parents argue she 'passed initially' and the lifeguards are 'overstepping.'
extension: passedDeepWaterTest: Patron -> lone Bool -- whether the patron has passed the deep-water tread / swim-to-the-side proficiency test

diagnosis.missing: The user says the child has NOT passed the deep-water tread / swim-to-the-side test — i.e., a proficiency/skill-test status that qualifies or disqualifies a patron from deep water, distinct from the wristband color itself.
diagnosis.closest: Checked Patron.wristband (only records the color, not why it was issued or whether the deep-water test was passed), Patron.highRiskCertifications (certifications, not swim-proficiency test results), Patron.isRegisteredAthlete (blue-band athlete check, unrelated), Patron.medicalClearance (medical, not skill), and DivingArea fields (personsOnApparatus, previousDiverSurfaced, previousDiverReachedWall — all about the dive sequence, not the patron's test status). None can express "has not passed the deep-water tread / swim-to-the-side test."
